Just posting this to rant.

I know many friends who have little to no willpower, who quit smoking only to start smoking again within 1 to 2 weeks, all the while bitching about how much they "need a fag in my life right now" (I'm British, this is a direct quote from a friend who was quitting).

Plenty of friends who try to diet who constantly "cheat" by going to MacDonalds, apparently "You need to treat yourself otherwise it's impossible to stay to a diet" how is disgustingly fatty horrible food a "treat"? A satsuma or nectarine is a treat.

And friends who constantly complain about having money issues even though I know their rent is lower than mine and they work more hours than me, and when I ask where their money is going they reply with "I just don't knowwww mannn!" even though they've just replaced their perfectly good TV with one 2 inches bigger, or pre-ordered 3 more games, or bought a shitty designer t shirt, or went on 3 nights out in one week and didn't take the cheaper option of drinking water instead of alcohol. They will then go on to ask me for a loan so they can make rent, as if I believe they have the willpower not to blow that money on taxis to work when they live a 5 minute walk from work.

In the past 2 years I've quit smoking, it was easy as hell, I simply don't go to the shop, don't buy cigarettes and a lighter, don't set fire to a cigarette, put it to my lips and inhale. It's literally impossible to accidentally smoke because of an urge, there are so many barriers to doing it. You have to actively fail and when I see someone smoking who said they have quit I openly mock them. I've only decided to quit once, I went cold turkey (Instead of these willpowerless fools who vape to quit and then stick on the vape for a year and then go back to cigs) and it was easy as fuck.

I've also quit eating all junk foods and fizzy drinks. Since I've made that decision I haven't drank coke/pepsi etc, and I haven't eaten crisps (potato chips), chocolate bars and junk like that. It's really easy since fruit and vegetables are so tasty (Now that I'm used to them) I've even cut out all sugar from my teas and coffees. I cannot show sympathy to someone who says they are trying to lose weight but have take-away food, fast food and fizzy drinks all the time. They complain about "carbs" like that shit matters, just eat less and put the fucking brownie down! I've even had one of them tell me I was wasting away and had an eating disorder because I have an apple and a banana to sustain me on my 4 hour work day.

As far as money is concerned, I work a minimum wage part time job and in my savings I currently have over 20 weeks worth of wages, this time last year I had 10 weeks worth of wages saved up. I know exactly where every pound has gone per week, I cannot comprehend being so mindlessly compulsive so not know what you're actually spending your money on.

I fucking hate people who refuse to believe they have free will and actual willpower and just follow every inane urge their body has.

I'm sorry for the rant, thank you for listening.

Edit: I'm not as mean as this post makes me come off. It just hurts when a friend asks for my support and I give it to them, but they're unwilling to help themselves.
I cannot respect those without willpower.
